name: Load balancer
summary: Internal (private) load balancer distributing traffic across backend VM or VMSS instances, with health probes.
useWhen: You need to distribute traffic across a fleet of VMs with health-based routing
You need a stable private IP in front of instances that scale in and out
avoidWhen: You need internet-facing load balancing with WAF (use Application Gateway or Front Door instead)
You're load-balancing container apps or App Service, which already have built-in load balancing
